user_saw: The CLI showed a bare Gateway timeout even though the agent had already been deleted.
summary: Human-facing Gateway timeouts after dispatch now explain that the outcome is unknown and advise checking state before retrying.
reasoning: The generic Gateway timeout formatter predates the July 1 history boundary and described the client deadline without addressing the write outcome. PR #126743 narrowed offline fallback to pre-connect failures and missing credentials, so the agent deletion command began surfacing the existing timeout directly when a dispatched write went unconfirmed. The fix report reproduced that path by withholding the successful reply and confirming that the agent was gone.
